# Ecomshoot
> Premium E-Commerce Product Photography & Creative Production Agency

## Company Overview
Ecomshoot is a premier commercial product photography studio and post-production house serving direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, high-growth Shopify merchants, Amazon enterprise sellers, and international fashion retailers. We specialize in studio-grade white background catalog photography, lifestyle editorial staging, high-fashion apparel model shoots, micro-detailed luxury jewellery imagery, 360-degree interactive product spins, and pixel-precise commercial retouching.

## Commercial Photography Services
- [Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/product-photography): Create clean and detailed images for your catalogues, websites and ads. We use controlled lighting to show your product in true colour, shape and finish.
- [E-Commerce Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/ecommerce-product-photography): Create consistent sets of images for your online store. We use the correct angles, backgrounds and sizing for your e-commerce product photography.
- [Lifestyle Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/lifestyle-product-photography): Showcase your product in a realistic environment. This could be on a kitchen counter, desk or travel bag.
- [Fashion & Apparel Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/fashion-product-photography): Create model, ghost mannequin and flat lay images to showcase your product’s fit, drape and detail.
- [Creative & Advertising Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/creative-product-photography): Create concept images for your advertising campaigns, social media and launches. We include props, colour palettes and motion.
- [Jewellery & Luxury Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/jewellery-product-photography): Create macro images for your rings, watches and accessories. We use controlled reflections with no dust or fingerprints.
- [Product Photo Editing & Retouching](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/product-photo-editing-retouching): We clean up the background, match colours, add shadows and remove any imperfections.
- [White Background Product Photography](http://127.0.0.1:8000/service/white-background-product-photography): Create clean white images that are compliant with your marketplace. This includes Amazon, Flipkart & Shopify.
